name: Hououji Urara
source:
A real-life Princess Kaguya who constantly receives marriage proposals. The daughter of a major conglomerate, she's capricious, spoiled, and quick to sulk.

When in a good mood, she can be straightforward and show an age-appropriate cuteness. Though frail and raised with great care, she never shows it.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/senpai/chara/chara.htmll] official site[/url]]
